title: CI fails when the PR names no record
goal: Every PR is named by a record, a task or the reconciliation log before it merges
acceptance: A committed test: a branch naming the PR number in a record, a task `prs` entry or the reconciliation log passes; one naming it nowhere fails and lists the files to edit
`ci.yml` runs `tools/check-pr-record.mjs` on pull_request with the PR number from the event; a push without a PR is skipped; `tools/check-backlog.mjs` (copied) is not changed
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-16: one script over docs/work and the reconciliation log, a CI step and a test. Not a measurement.
